screening_decisions.reason: Parallel-group randomized trial in adults with frozen shoulder; all taught pendular exercises, and one arm received glenohumeral mobilisations (manual therapy). Compares against steroid injection, ice, or no treatment—meets manual therapy/exercise trial criteria.
Observational primary care incidence/management study across shoulder disorders; not an RCT/quasi-RCT and not focused exclusively on adhesive capsulitis interventions.
Educational/review article on mobilization principles (Kaltenborn approach); no randomized or quasi-randomized clinical trial, not specific to adhesive capsulitis.

Open randomized controlled trial in frozen shoulder comparing physical therapies including therapeutic exercises versus the same PT plus distension arthrography with intra-articular steroid; exercise present as core PT component.
Methodological review on protocols/registries versus publications; not a clinical trial in adhesive capsulitis and no manual therapy/exercise intervention.
Randomized controlled trial in idiopathic adhesive capsulitis evaluating deep transverse friction massage and capsular stretching (manual therapy/exercise).
Randomized comparison of two supervised exercise programs for frozen shoulder (glenohumeral ROM exercises with/without scapulothoracic exercises), assessing pain and ROM outcomes.
Randomized multiple-treatment trial in frozen shoulder syndrome comparing end-range, mid-range, and mobilization-with-movement techniques (manual therapy) across treatment periods.

Comparative trial in chronic peri-arthritis (frozen shoulder) assessing PNF movement patterns versus conventional free exercises to improve ROM (exercise-based). Randomization not explicit—include conservatively at title/abstract stage.
Pilot randomized study in adhesive capsulitis comparing antero-posterior versus postero-anterior glenohumeral joint glides (manual therapy) on external rotation ROM.
Cross-sectional prevalence/impact study in the general population; not an interventional randomized/quasi-randomized trial.
Multiple-subject case report on end-range mobilization in adhesive capsulitis; uncontrolled—does not meet RCT/quasi-RCT design.

Placebo-controlled randomized trial in adhesive capsulitis with four arms (corticosteroid injection, supervised physiotherapy, combination, and placebo). All participants taught a home exercise program—fits exercise focus.
Randomized, placebo-controlled trial following joint distension for adhesive capsulitis, comparing manual therapy + directed exercise versus sham ultrasound; reports pain/function/ROM and QoL.
Measurement responsiveness study of the Shoulder Disability Questionnaire; not a randomized trial and not an intervention study in adhesive capsulitis.
Comparative study of acupuncture and physical therapy in frozen shoulder without evidence of randomization; outside RCT/quasi-RCT scope.
Systematic review and cost-effectiveness analysis; secondary research—not a primary RCT/quasi-RCT.

Comparative study in shoulder adhesive capsulitis of anterior vs posterior glide mobilization to improve internal rotation (manual therapy); randomization not stated—potentially quasi-randomized; include conservatively.
Methodological study on outcome reporting bias in RCTs; not specific to adhesive capsulitis and no manual therapy/exercise intervention.

Study on deep versus superficial heating for frozen shoulder (modalities rather than exercise/manual therapy); abstract provided is mismatched and non-relevant; does not evaluate manual therapy or exercise as interventions.
Randomized clinical trial comparing corticosteroid injection, physiotherapy, and their combination for frozen shoulder; physiotherapy includes exercise.

Randomized study comparing Cyriax approach (deep friction massage + mobilization exercises) versus conventional PT including modalities with stretching/home exercise—manual therapy and exercise components.
Prospective natural history study of frozen shoulder without randomized intervention; not an RCT/quasi-RCT.
Methods paper on quantifying heterogeneity in meta-analysis; not a clinical trial.
Handbook chapter on reporting biases; not a primary randomized/quasi-randomized trial.
Prospective natural history cohort in frozen shoulder; no randomized allocation or evaluation of manual therapy/exercise as trial interventions.
Randomized trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing joint mobilization plus active exercises versus exercises alone; reports pain and ROM outcomes; meets population, design, and intervention criteria.

RCT in adhesive capsulitis comparing sodium hyaluronate vs steroid vs physical therapy modalities vs control. Abstract specifies ‘physical therapy modalities’ without describing exercise or manual therapy; interventions appear modalities-only and thus outside the manual therapy/exercise scope.
Electromyographic analysis during exercises in subjects with/without shoulder pathology; not an interventional RCT in adhesive capsulitis.
Comparative study in chronic shoulder pain of mixed etiologies; adhesive capsulitis population not specified; outside target population.
Randomized comparison of local corticosteroid injection versus physiotherapy in adhesive capsulitis; physiotherapy constitutes a rehabilitation intervention relevant to exercise/manual therapy scope.
Methods chapter (not a clinical trial); outside study design scope.
Retrospective study of painful stiff shoulder; not randomized/quasi-randomized.
Randomized controlled study directly comparing two manual mobilization techniques (Mulligan vs Maitland) in adhesive capsulitis; matches intervention and design criteria.
Methods chapter (not a clinical trial).
Population-based consultation patterns; epidemiological, not an interventional RCT in adhesive capsulitis.

Randomized comparison of iontophoresis vs phonophoresis in ‘shoulder periarthritis’; neither manual therapy nor exercise as interventions of interest; population may not be limited to adhesive capsulitis.

Observer-blind randomized trial in ‘painful stiff shoulder’ (commonly used synonym for adhesive capsulitis) comparing local steroid injection, physiotherapy (6 weeks), and both; includes a physiotherapy arm relevant to exercise/manual therapy.

Double-blinded RCT in frozen shoulder adding electroacupuncture or interferential electrotherapy to shoulder exercises versus no treatment; includes an exercise-based intervention (exercise plus adjunct).
Randomized controlled trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing ibuprofen alone versus ibuprofen plus a combined physical therapy technique; evaluates added benefit of PT consistent with review scope.

Randomized controlled trial in chronic adhesive capsulitis assessing end-range mobilization techniques added to exercises/ultrasound versus exercises/ultrasound alone; manual therapy plus exercise fits scope.

Randomized clinical trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing anterior vs posterior glide joint mobilizations with adjunct ultrasound and ergometer exercise; manual therapy intervention satisfies criteria.
Factorial RCT in adhesive capsulitis (triamcinolone injection and/or standardized physiotherapy), with home exercise for all; physiotherapy and exercise components are within scope.

Prospective randomized trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing manipulation under anesthesia, peri-articular injection, and physiotherapy; includes a physiotherapy arm relevant to manual therapy/exercise.
Systematic review; not a primary randomized/quasi-randomized trial.
Methods chapter on meta-analysis; not a clinical trial.

Despite title wording, abstract describes a prospective observational analysis of mobilization session frequency and self-exercise compliance without randomized allocation; does not meet RCT/quasi-RCT design criterion.

Prospective, systematically allocated clinical trial comparing chiropractic manipulation + exercise vs mobilization + exercise in adhesive capsulitis; allocation likely quasi-random; includes manual therapy and exercise.
Randomized controlled trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing high-grade versus low-grade mobilization techniques; manual therapy intervention matches scope.
Randomized single-blind pilot adding passive joint mobilization to a home-care program after corticosteroid injection in adhesive capsulitis; manual therapy plus exercise context in scope.
